title: PMNS CP phase delta_CP/pi = (k-1)/Phi_4 = 11/10 in W(3,3)
checks: W33 prediction in NuFit 5.2 NH +- 2 sigma range

boundary_target.scheme: PMNS lepton-mixing CP phase, NH ordering

external_inputs.source: NuFit 5.2 (Esteban et al. 2023) NH best fit

pmns_complete.comment: All four PMNS parameters now have W(3,3) closed forms. The PMNS matrix structure of lepton mixing is fully W(3,3)-fixed.

theorem_statement: The PMNS lepton-mixing CP phase admits a clean W(3,3) closed form delta_CP / pi = (k-1)/Phi_4 = 11/10, predicting delta_CP = 198 deg.  NuFit 5.2 NH best fit gives delta_CP/pi = 1.08 +- 0.125 (sigma_lower~0.12, sigma_upper~0.13).  Residual +0.02 (z = +0.16), within 0.2 sigma.  This completes the PMNS matrix structure in W(3,3): all three mixing angles (CCCXXXVI) plus the CP phase are now W(3,3)-fixed.
honesty_boundary: NuFit 5.2 has substantial uncertainty (~25 deg) on delta_CP from current T2K/NOvA data.  DUNE, Hyper-K, JUNO upcoming experiments will sharpen this to ~5 deg precision over the next decade. The W(3,3) prediction 198 deg is currently consistent with NH best fit at <0.2 sigma but could be tested definitively by future precision measurements.  IH ordering disfavored by current data; W(3,3) prediction applies to NH.
